captions.detailed: A compact, modern bench lamp featuring a dark gray rectangular base, two articulating silver metal arm links, and a dark gray cylindrical spotlight head. The base has an integrated side rocker switch that can pivot. The lower arm link rotates on a hinge mounted to the base, the upper arm link rotates on a hinge at the elbow joint, and the spotlight head tilts on a bracket hinge at the end of the arm.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated bench lamp with a rectangular base, a side rocker switch, a two-link articulated arm, and a cylindrical spotlight head. Define revolute joints for the rocker switch, the base hinge, the elbow hinge, and the head tilt bracket to allow full articulation.
captions.factory: Construct the lamp using multiple parts: a 'base' part made from a filleted box with a hinge mount and a small rocker switch; a 'lower_link' part modeled as a rectangular bar with a cylindrical hinge pin; an 'upper_link' part modeled as a parallel-beam arm; and a 'head' part consisting of a cylindrical spotlight and a U-bracket. Connect these parts chronologically using revolute joints ('switch_joint', 'base_joint', 'elbow_joint', and 'head_joint') with defined rotation axes and limits.
